description: Local verifier: open a run on a task's submitted head_sha. Returns the run id, the SHA to check out, the checks to run and the criteria to judge. The run lease is 30 minutes; every record_* call extends it. Check out exactly head_sha in a clean worktree, never the executor's working tree.

verifier_key.description: Your verifier key (MINDPM_VERIFIER_KEY or MINDPM_REVIEWER_KEY). Never pass it to an executor
